items.title: [Steam新闻] V2.6.1 The Sinner’s Exile
items.summary: In the fairy tale everyone knows, a noble knight saves the princess.In the story no one knows, a loyal knight forsakes his oath.Virtue is sung for all to hear... but what of sin?The old castle 🏰 sees no visitors anymore,yet the new sun ☀️ rises as it always has.The exiled knight will never be alone—he has his shadow beside him. He has only his shadow beside him.
